proof_diff.before: Chapter IV Corollary5.5, p.128, gives log_F(T)=sum a_n T^n/n with integral a_n and a_1=1. Lemmas6.2–6.3 and Theorem6.4, pp.130–132, apply over a complete characteristic-zero discretely valued field, with v(K*)=Z and residue characteristic p. The logarithm is a homomorphism on F(m), and is an isomorphism from F(m^r) to the additive m^r for integral r>v(p)/(p-1). These are statements for the indicated formal group, not for all elliptic-curve points.

proof_diff.before: For 1/x([n]P_0)=a+bs, extraction uses a=(w+conj(w))/2 and b=(w-conj(w))/(2s). At odd places these denominators are units, with both conjugate places included. At2 their valuations are2 and3, so at most3 is lost. Since the extracted coefficients are rational, both coefficients have rational p-valuation at least4v_p(N_s) for every p dividing N_s. Thus a,b belong to N_s^4 Z_(N_s).
